test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: An article is sold at a profit of 25%. If its cost price is reduced by 20% and it is sold at the same selling price, then what will be the profit per cent?
solution:
**Given:**

Profit = 25%, CP is reduced = 20%

**Formula used:**

SP = CP × (100 + P%)/100

Profit = SP - CP

Profit% = P × 100/CP

**Calculation:**

Let CP be Rs. 100

SP = 100 × (100 + 25)/100 = 125

If CP is reduced 20%, then CP = 80

But SP is the same i.e Rs. 125

Profit = 125 - 80 = 45

Profit% = 45 × 100/80 = ​56(1)/(4)​​%

**​∴ The profit % is 56(1)/(4)%**
